scope.coverage_rule: Every visible body-text region must be represented. Tables, form fields, image-embedded instructions, signatures and repeated layout regions must be evaluated explicitly rather than inferred from extracted text.

semantic_states.detected: The feature was evaluated and found.
semantic_states.not_detected: The feature was evaluated with a capable detector and was not found.
semantic_states.not_evaluated: No capable detector evaluated the feature.
semantic_states.not_found: Extraction was attempted but no supported value was found.

global_acceptance_criteria: All 77 pages remain present, ordered, unique and contiguous.
A page is not considered complete merely because another page in the same document contains enough words.
Real OCR confidence is nullable and may be called measured only when returned by a capable OCR engine or library.
Unknown detection capability is represented as not_evaluated, never as false.
Route is provenance/prior evidence and cannot override an explicit document title without a conflict warning.
Version, code and date values include source evidence; filename timestamps are not documentary evidence.
Tables and forms preserve row, column, field and label relationships.
Repeated headers, footers and watermarks are retained as auditable layout observations and excluded from repeated indexable body text.
Raw text remains auditable; normalized corrections and removed spans are recorded.
Any unresolved source inconsistency or materially incomplete page sets processing_status to needs_review.
